Irreversible electroporation for locally advanced pancreatic cancer: a prospective cohort.
Ninety patients received electroporation ablation with a median survival of 18 months.

Nanoknife ablation of the pancreas: a multicentre registry.
The nanoknife device delivered 90 pulses across three electrodes.

Thermal radiofrequency ablation of liver tumours.
Radiofrequency electrodes were placed percutaneously; no pancreas involvement in this series.

EUS-guided fiducial placement before stereotactic radiotherapy.
No ablation device was used in this cohort.

Nanoknife ablation of the pancreas: a multicentre registry.
The nanoknife device delivered 90 pulses across three electrodes.
